title: Auth — shared passkey-invite summary
description: What an administrator may read back about a passkey enrolment invite after issuing it. Deliberately omits the invite token, its URL and the claim code: an unredeemed token is a credential to bind a passkey to somebody else's VID, so it is disclosed once, at issuance, and never again.

inviteId.description: Consumer-chosen opaque handle for the invite. It is NOT the invite token and MUST NOT be derivable into it; knowing it lets an administrator manage the invite, never redeem it.

subject.description: The VID the invite binds a passkey to.

purpose.description: What the redeemed credential may authenticate, as in auth/passkey/enroll/invite.

role.description: The role the invitee receives on redemption. Absent when the consumer applies its default role, and always absent for purpose stepUp.

expired.description: True when expiresAt has passed. An expired invite can no longer be redeemed; it is listed until the consumer's cleanup removes it.
